{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of patients with sample_seq > 1:", (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum())
print("Unique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("Unique severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())
print("Responded values:", df['responded'].unique())
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())"}
